strings.La lista de recientes guarda las últimas:
The recent list keeps the last folders used throughout the program and is in the menu of the toolbar's Back button.

Each tab also has its own history, which the Back and Forward buttons move through.
strings.Las carpetas que más usas aparecen solas:
The folders you use most appear by themselves below your favorites.

Each action gives its folder a number of points, editable on the Scoring page, and those that collect enough are shown in the list.
strings.Los favoritos dan acceso rápido a carpet:
Favorites give quick access to folders and files from the ★ button of each pane, the Favorites menu and the folder tree. Branches group them into submenus. Drag them to sort them or to put them in a branch.

Whatever you put in “Favorites bar” appears on that bar, if it is visible; the rest, in its ★ Other Favorites button.

strings.Los puntos que da cada acción a la carpe: The points each action gives to the folder where it happens. The folders with the most points are the ones that appear in smart favorites.
